name: azurepwq.com
description: Personal website with documentation and favicon implementation

scripts.help:commit:
echo "You can use either:
- Regular git commit: git commit -m 'Type: Your message'
- Guided commit wizard: npm run commit

Both methods will validate your commit message format."
scripts.help:
echo "Available commands:

Development:
  npm run dev         # Start Jekyll server with livereload
  npm run build       # Build the site
  npm run sync        # Sync README.md to index.md
  npm run watch       # Watch README.md for changes
  npm run start       # Run dev + watch simultaneously

Versioning:
  npm run release     # Automatic version increment
  npm run release:patch  # Increment patch version
  npm run release:minor  # Increment minor version
  npm run release:major  # Increment major version

Commits:
  npm run commit      # Use guided commit wizard
"
